question: From a point P on a level ground, the angle of elevation of the top of a tower is 30°. If the tower is 110sqrt 3 m high, what is the distance (in m) of point P from the foot of the tower?
solution:
**Given:**

The angle of elevation of the top of a tower = 30°

The height of the tower = 110√3 m

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c977df5e511ac02a2743ce832be3ac9ca12693d9dddf876bb7e08a0d885675c.png] **

AB = 110√3 m

tan 30° = AB/PB

⇒ 1/√3 = 110√3/PB

⇒ PB = 110√3 × √3

⇒ PB = 110 × 3 = 330 m

**∴ The distance (in m) of point P from the foot of the tower is 330 m**
